question: Which sport is related with AFC Challenge Cup?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Football**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The AFC Challenge Cup is related to football: 
 
• The AFC Challenge Cup was a continental football competition created by the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) to improve the standard of Asian football. 
 
• The first AFC Challenge Cup was held in Bangladesh in 2006, and the winners automatically qualified for the AFC Asian Cup starting in 2008. 
 
• The 2014 tournament was the last edition of the AFC Challenge Cup, as the Asian Cup expanded to 24 teams after 2015. 
 
• The AFC created the AFC Solidarity Cup in 2016 to replace the AFC Challenge Cup. 
 
• The AFC Challenge League 2024-25 is an 18-team tournament featuring 12 teams from West Asia and six from East Asia.
